title: Discover TDD for an explicit test-first request
prompt: I want to add is_even() to module.py using test-driven development. Before changing files, describe the first red-green-refactor slice and the minimum test evidence you would use.

title: Do not discover TDD for an ordinary integration-test request
prompt: Recommend one integration test for the existing greet() behavior in module.py. I am not asking for TDD or test-first development, and do not change the implementation.
